description: Full cluster & consensus report for ONE token (Solana mint or Base contract address; chain auto-detected). Detects whether tracked smart-money wallets are converging on the token in the last 24h: tracked buyer/seller counts, per-wallet cluster events (side, tx count, estimated USD, first/last seen), tracked net USD flow, tracked wallets sitting in the top-holder list, and a 0-100 consensus score with a STRONG / FORMING / QUIET / EXITING signal and a stated confidence. Fuses a safety summary (RugCheck on Solana, GoPlus on Base) and a canonical check: for tokens trading on a registered narrative name (NEET at launch) it states CANONICAL or CLONE and names the real contract — ticker copies are industrial-scale and resolving the real one is the toll. FAIL-CLOSED AND HONEST ABOUT COVERAGE: Solana cluster detection is sample-based (a bounded sample of recent main-pool transactions intersected with the tracked set); every report states signatures seen, transactions parsed and the sample span, and missing sources cap confidence and are named in data_gaps — a consensus score is only produced when real cluster data answered. Base support is holder-overlap plus a bounded transfer-log scan and is labelled a weaker signal. The tracked set is derived from public data (repeat cross-token buyers on public RPC flow + GoPlus holder lists), shipped as data and rebuildable. Cost: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (Base settlement; Solana settlement when configured) — no API key needed. Use it before apeing into any social-driven token: are the wallets that matter already in, still entering, or leaving?

address.description: Token address: a Solana mint (base58, e.g. Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump) or a Base contract (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars). Chain is auto-detected from the format.

name: cluster_check
